claim: Simultaneous knockdown of MAF1 with Pol III diminished the activation and looping effect.

claim: CDKN1A mediates p53-dependent cell-cycle arrest at the G1 phase.

claim: Enhanced binding of Pol III after MAF1 knockdown induced chromatin looping.
source: Enhanced binding of Pol III after MAF1 knockdown induced CDKN1A transcription and chromatin looping by recruiting common Pol II and Pol III transcription factors as well as binding of TBP, p300, CFP1, and PCAF, along with increase in histone modifications associated with gene activation.

claim: Simultaneous knockdown of Pol III and MAF1 abolished activation of CDKN1A transcription.
source: Simultaneous knockdown of Pol III and MAF1 abolished both promoter looping and activation of CDKN1A transcription, which indicates that Pol III actively participated in regulation of Pol II genes.
evidence: Supported by expression data in Figure 1D.

claim: Pol III actively participates in regulation of Pol II genes.
source: Simultaneous knockdown of Pol III and MAF1 abolished both promoter looping and activation of CDKN1A transcription, which indicates that Pol III actively participated in regulation of Pol II genes.

claim: Binding of MAF1 regulates Pol III-mediated transcriptional activation and chromatin looping of Pol II genes.

source: MAF1 knockdown strongly upregulated CDKN1A expression

claim: MAF1 knockdown arrested cells at the G1 phase.

evidence: Supported by citation to previous literature.

claim: CDKN1A expression was induced after MAF1 knockdown in both wild-type and p53-null HCT116.

claim: CDKN1A activation by MAF1 knockdown is independent of p53.
source: CDKN1A expression was induced after MAF1 knockdown in both wild-type and p53-null HCT116, which indicates that the activation is independent of p53 (Figure 1—figure supplement 1B,C).
evidence: This is an inference from the observation that CDKN1A is induced in p53-null cells.

claim: MAF1 can regulate CDKN1A expression in a variety of cell types independent of p53.

claim: Pol III is required for the induction of CDKN1A upon MAF1 knockdown.

claim: R-loop formation positively correlates with active transcription in human cells.

claim: R-loop formation maintains the unmethylated state at promoters with skewed GC content.

claim: MAF1 knockdown resulted in the formation of extended R-loop in the gene body of CDKN1A.

claim: Extended R-loop formation in CDKN1A indicates active transcription.

claim: Simultaneous knockdown of Pol III and MAF1 inhibited R-loop formation in CDKN1A.

evidence: Supported by R-loop foot-printing data in Figure 2C-E.

claim: R-looping of ACTB was not affected by MAF1 knockdown.

claim: ACTB is an active housekeeping gene with high GC skew and expression.

claim: H3K27me3 decreased after MAF1 knockdown.

claim: H3K27me3 level was restored under simultaneous knockdown of Pol III and MAF1.
